# Vendor frontend libraries

## Apache ECharts

- File: `echarts.min.js`
- Version: `5.5.1`
- Source: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/echarts@5.5.1/dist/echarts.min.js`
- Purpose: interactive comparator charts.

## Choices.js

- Files: `choices.min.js`, `choices.min.css`
- Version: `10.2.0`
- Source: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/choices.js@10.2.0/public/assets/`
- Purpose: polished select controls for proposal-specific CLI configuration.

Keep this file versioned so the comparator does not depend on an external CDN at runtime.
